sentences.text: IPMA has issued a yellow rain warning for the Lisboa district from 2026-11-18 17:19 to 2026-11-18 20:00 local time.
Today's forecast for Lisboa gives a minimum of 15.9 °C, a maximum of 20.9 °C and a chance of rain of 100%, with moderate wind from W.
An orange warning for rough sea covers the Lisboa district from 2026-11-19 06:00 to 2026-11-19 12:00 local time.
The sea forecast for the Lisboa coast on 2026-11-19 shows waves of 3.6 to 4.1 metres from NW and a sea temperature of 17.4 to 17.6 °C.
Tomorrow, 2026-11-19, Lisboa is forecast a minimum of 12.7 °C, a maximum of 18.5 °C and a chance of rain of 2%, with moderate wind from W.
